stem:
Models R and T are shown.

Model R           Model T

options.label: A
options.text: The shaded parts of Model R and Model T are different sizes, but each model represents the same fraction of the whole.

options.label: B
options.text: The shaded part of Model R cannot be written as the fraction \( \frac{1}{5} \), because the parts are not all equal in size.

options.label: C
options.text: The shaded part of Model T is \( \frac{1}{4} \), because the parts are all equal in size.

options.label: D
options.text: The total number of parts in Model R is 5, so \( \frac{1}{5} \) of Model R is shaded.

visual_elements: Two pie charts labeled Model R and Model T. Model R is divided into 5 parts with one part shaded gray, but parts are unequal in size. Model T is divided into 5 equal parts with one part shaded gray.
difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding fractions, equal parts, and interpreting shaded areas in two different models with unequal and equal parts.
